notice: Demonstration guidance requiring clinical review before production use.
emergencyCallInstruction: Call 112 for serious injury, heavy bleeding, loss of consciousness, abnormal breathing, or severe pain.
doActions: Keep the person still and comfortable.
doNotActions: Do not move the person unless there is immediate danger.
Do not give food, drink, or medicine.
escalationRule: Report reduced responsiveness, abnormal breathing, or new heavy bleeding to 112 immediately.
